caseReports.indication: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease patients on dialysis; oxylanthanum carbonate

source_classification.finding: Issuer disclosed an FDA cGMP deficiency at a third-party manufacturing vendor and that labeling discussions were precluded. This was public before the June 26 research cutoff; it does not by itself establish the eventual FDA decision.
Original 2025 CRL PDF is located with partial extracted text and Reference ID 5616346. First-page verification remains required; the filename is not proof of original publication.

UNI-OLC-201 enrolled 106 patients; 86 entered the safety population and 71 the evaluable maintenance population. Treatment-related maintenance discontinuation was 1/71; all adverse-event discontinuations were 5/86, including three treatment-related. Phosphate control was reported in 77/86 after titration. The study was not designed to evaluate efficacy and lacked a concurrent active comparator. The issuer comparison with Fosrenol historical discontinuation cannot establish comparative safety or efficacy.
A later-cycle CRL references the June 27, 2025 action; it must not replace the original cycle or enter 2025 clinical/manufacturing prediction inputs.

Formulation and manufacturing identity differ.
